title: "Wildfires"
author: "Chloe Mercurio"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
print(length(raw$features))

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
print(names(first_fire))

first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
print(first_coordinate)

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)
print(wildfires)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(
    incident,
    stringr::regex("August", ignore_case = TRUE)
  ))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10) |>
  dplyr::select(incident, gis_acres)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(coordinates) mean(purrr::map_dbl(
        coordinates[[1]],
        \(pair) as.numeric(pair[[1]])
      ))
    ),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(coordinates) mean(purrr::map_dbl(
        coordinates[[1]],
        \(pair) as.numeric(pair[[2]])
      ))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

map <- leaflet::leaflet() |>
  leaflet::addTiles()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_fires))) {
  boundary <- top_fires$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]]
  longitude <- purrr::map_dbl(boundary, \(point) as.numeric(point[[1]]))
  latitude <- purrr::map_dbl(boundary, \(point) as.numeric(point[[2]]))
  popup <- paste0(
    "<strong>", htmltools::htmlEscape(top_fires$incident[[i]]), "</strong>",
    "<br>Year: ", top_fires$fire_year[[i]],
    "<br>Acres: ", scales::comma(top_fires$gis_acres[[i]])
  )

  map <- map |>
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      lng = longitude,
      lat = latitude,
      popup = popup
    )
}

all_boundaries <- purrr::map(
  top_fires$geometry_coordinates,
  \(coordinates) coordinates[[1]]
) |>
  purrr::flatten()
all_longitudes <- purrr::map_dbl(
  all_boundaries,
  \(point) as.numeric(point[[1]])
)
all_latitudes <- purrr::map_dbl(
  all_boundaries,
  \(point) as.numeric(point[[2]])
)

map |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(all_longitudes),
    lat1 = min(all_latitudes),
    lng2 = max(all_longitudes),
    lat2 = max(all_latitudes)
  )
```
